content: <thought>Based on the mass spectrum (indicating a Cl + Br combination), the 13C NMR (six aromatic carbons consistent with a para‑disubstituted phenyl) and the 1H NMR (CHCl at ~4.6 ppm, CH2 at ~2.0 ppm, CH3 at ~0.85 ppm, and four aromatic protons), the structure is best described as a para‑bromophenyl ring bearing a 1‑chloro‑2‑propyl substituent. The SMILES that matches these data is c1ccc(Br)cc1C(Cl)CC.
